integrity: The exact boundary is reproduced by a pair-first exhaustive enumeration through total size fifteen and an independent union-first decomposition of every fifteen-voter anonymous profile, with exact pair-set equality.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three candidates, strict complete anonymous ballots, and profiles with unique maximin winners. Tie-dependent instances and individually labeled-voter counts are outside scope.
title: Complete minimal-boundary reinforcement census for three-candidate maximin
